text_block_list.text:
—Who was it that started saying that, I 
wonder?

That they are the true "Golden 
Generation."

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it true? That those girls are 
gathering to train together today...

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So it seems, hehe... How exciting. —Wait, 
what?
Thanks for waiting~~!!

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text: Here it comes!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm so happy that all of us get to 
make our debut together this year!

—Special Week. Transferring from the 
countryside all on her own to fulfill a 
promise to her mother, she is an Umamusume 
constantly at the center of attention.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm delighted to run alongside 
everyone too~. Shall we get right to 
running side-by-side, then?

—Grass Wonder. A Yamato Nadeshiko from 
abroad. Possessing an iron will behind her 
gentle demeanor, she's an Umamusume who's 
turned heads since the Debut Races.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~? You're not thinking of starting 
with just the two of you, are you~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest phantom bird has arrived! A 
race without El is like a taco without hot 
sauce, don'tcha know!?"

—El Condor Pasa. Aiming to become the 
world's strongest, she's captivated people 
since before her debut. A natural-born 
performer, one might say.

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...What an incredible lineup. As a 
reporter, it's hard to decide who to focus 
on.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oops, hello everyone. All gathered, I see~ 
Well, let's not waste any time, so...

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Seiun Sky. To think that elusive 
girl is from the same generation 
too—this'll be fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, hey, hey!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, haven't you forgotten someone!? 
That's right, the leading star of the 
"Golden Generation"—me—

"...And that Umamusume who's been suddenly 
shouting and showing off for a while now. 
She is none other than—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
About the first-rate Umamusume, King 
Halo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, where is everyone's applause? 
Where are the cries of "Bravo"?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to freely praise King, you 
know? Come on, don't hold back!

...Yes, she is none other than King Halo, 
the Umamusume I train.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer, you too! Don't hide 
your praise for the Kingâapplaud with 
all your might!!

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...King Halo. The daughter of that 
legendary Umamusume who won countless GIs. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Reporter
text_block_list.text:
No, but she is that mother's daughter. We 
shouldn't underestimate her... probably.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Traineeer!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh, I see. So you're saying you 
deliberately kept quiet just now?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no need to be so modest. I know it 
must be intimidating to speak to someone 
as elegant as me, captivating everyone's 
gaze, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chaaan? Everyone else is already done 
warming up, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no you don't, Spe-chan. We gotta start 
while everyone's distracted by that young 
lady.

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! It's finally starting! The tandem 
training run of the "Golden Generation"!
choice_data_list:
If we don't hurry, it's gonna start 
without us!

If we don't hurry, it's going to start 
without us!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? ...Geez~~! I haven't even gotten 
through half of my self-introduction yet~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone, wait up!! The biggest star 
of the year is still right here, you 
know?!
(*SWOOOOSH――――――!!*)
—She ran as if she were truly flying.

"She dashes from the stands toward the 
track like the wind. With breathtaking 
acceleration—!"

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Heh... As expected of that lady's 
daughter...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, color me impressed! To think you 
could still make it in time from all the 
way back there!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd probably think 'no way' 
halfway through, give up, and go fishing 
instead, maybe-maybe?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. For King, throwing away victory 
by 'giving up' is simply not an option.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As long as there is hope of winning, I 
will stand and challenge again and again. 
That is who the King is!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Sky-san! We're running in 
tandem one more time!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give you the right to keep 
challenging me as many times as you like, 
until you lose!!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeh...? Isn't it usually the other way 
around~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Not being ordinary suits me just 
fine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am the first-rate Umamusume, 
King Halo. An Umamusume born with every 
talent, deserving of recognition!!"
...Truly self-centered. Utterly insolent.

And so began the days of challenging the 
Twinkle Series together with the selfish 
young lady, King Halo.
